thread:
maria: quick flag — during the 32k-context perf run this morning I saw steady KV cache memory growth across a few shards, even though evictions stayed ~0. wondering if our residency accounting or paging path is wrong. anyone seen this?

jake: saw it too when running long-context gen locally. resident_keys rises, fragmentation_ratio slowly increases, but kv_cache_evictions_total stays flat. looks like keys are being retained but not referenced.

sophia: can you paste the prometheus queries you used?

maria: pasted the main ones below.  grabbing model=gptx-32k shard=3 as the worst case.

```promql
sum by (shard) (kv_cache_memory_bytes{model="gptx-32k"})
kv_cache_resident_keys{model="gptx-32k"}
sum by (shard) (rate(kv_cache_evictions_total[5m])))
rate(kv_cache_fragmentation_ratio[1h])
```

eli: couple of immediate thoughts:
- we currently only increment evictions when we remove entire KV pages; if we compact/merge fragments in-place we may not increment the counter -> misleading.
- residency is a gauge sourced from sampler every N seconds; if sampler misses short-lived churn we under-report true churn and memory appears to grow.

jake: agree. also our exporter labels include request_id for a short window which blew up cardinality last quarter — I worry someone added a similar high-card label to residency metrics. check for extra labels.

sophia: for dashboarding I recommend 3 panels:
1) per-model aggregate memory_bytes (stacked by shard) + moving avg to show trend.
2) eviction_rate (5m) vs memory_growth_rate (5m) side-by-side.
3) residency heatmap: x=time, y=resident_kv_per_request (binned) to catch long-tail reuse patterns.

infra-bot: reminder: collector version v1.14.0 deployed 02:10 UTC — includes kv residency sampler changes.

maria: nice. who can add the eviction_rate recording rule + a small alert? proposal: fire when total_evictions_per_minute == 0 and memory_bytes increased > 50MB over 10m (for models with >1M resident keys).

eli: draft recording rule (yaml):
```yaml
- record: job:kv_cache_eviction_rate:rate5m
  expr: sum by (model, shard) (rate(kv_cache_evictions_total[5m]))
- record: job:kv_cache_mem_growth:delta10m
  expr: max_over_time(kv_cache_memory_bytes[10m]) - min_over_time(kv_cache_memory_bytes[10m])
```

sophia: +1 but tweak cardinality: label only by model and shard. avoid instance/request_id.

jake: we should also expose a per-request histogram for residency length so we can compute p50/p95/p99 resident tokens. something like kv_cache_residency_seconds_bucket with labels (model, shard, size_bin).

maria: agreed. action items: add recording rules (eli), update exporter to remove any high-card labels on kv metrics (jake), add the 3 dashboard panels and an alert (sophia). i'll run a 12h 32k context soak after those changes and post results.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: collector v1.14.1 -> staging at 17:42 UTC.

eli: final note — let's capture a small pprof trace on the worst shard when we hit the steady growth so we can see if we leak references in the merge/compact code path. low-overhead sampling only.

maria: perfect. tagging @ops to watch alerts during the soak. :eyes: 

sophia: thanks — I'll sketch the dashboard panels and post a gif mockup later. :+1:
